verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird does offer free, client-independent tools like the German Term Sheet Generator and the SCC Generator ('free to use'), plus downloadable factsheets (EMI, Growth Shares) and a GDPR guide — matching the 'term sheet' and general downloadable-forms part of the story. However there is no evidence of free incorporation document generators, SAFE templates, or NDA templates, which are explicitly named in the story. Missing for 10: incorporation document generator, SAFE template, NDA template, and any evidence these tools are usable without becoming a client in practice.
